interaction.provoke: A tap on the plate, or the Provoke button, answers with a short camera move toward the head in each era's manner: one lever-pulled clack (Maker), three spring notches (Mechanic), a strike with an optic flare (Advanced and canon). Sounds are synthesized in the browser with Web Audio at the moment of the tap; no audio file is added. Reduced-motion visitors get the status line, optic flare and sound without the camera move.
